questions.q: What are the zeros of x² − 5x + 6?
The graph of a quadratic polynomial is a ____.
questions.explanation: Quadratic polynomials give a U-shaped curve.

questions.q: For ax² + bx + c, the sum of the zeros is ____.
For ax² + bx + c, the product of the zeros is ____.
Which quadratic polynomial has zeros 2 and −3?
questions.explanation: Sum = −1 and product = −6, so x² − (sum)x + product = x² + x − 6.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of zeros a cubic polynomial can have?
questions.explanation: A polynomial of degree n has at most n zeros.
